task.title: Create form and delete buttons on the customers page
task.text:
What: let people create and delete customers from the customers page, with stable data-testid selectors on every part a browser automation needs.

Today the page only lists customers: src/web/server.ts answers only GET, and customersBody in src/web/customers.ts renders a Name/VAT table or "No customers yet." The owner approved this design (option A of TVMA33M's plan). It builds on TVMA33M's branch and lands into it.

Where: src/web/server.ts, src/web/customers.ts, a new src/web/app.ts, and their tests. The store in src/customers/index.ts already has list, get, create, update and remove; do not change it.

Routes (plain HTML forms, no JavaScript, no confirm dialog):
- GET /customers: the page with the create form above the list.
- POST /customers, form fields name and vat: saves the customer and redirects to /customers. If either field is empty, respond with an error status and show the page with a message in customer-form-error.
- POST /customers/:id/delete: deletes that customer and redirects to /customers; an unknown id answers not found.
- GET /api/customers: unchanged.
Move the request handling into src/web/app.ts so the routes can be unit-tested; server.ts only starts the server. Keep the page title "Customers" (owner's decision) and the existing empty-state text "No customers yet." Keep escaping all customer values through escape() in src/web/html.ts.

data-testid attributes, exactly these: the form customer-form; name field customer-name; VAT field customer-vat; "Add customer" button customer-submit; error message customer-form-error; empty-list message customers-empty; the table customer-list; each row customer-row, also carrying the customer's id in data-customer-id; each row's Delete button customer-delete. customersBody takes each customer's id to render these.

Tests: unit tests for customersBody (rows, ids, testids, empty state) and for the routes in app.ts (create, empty-field error, delete, unknown id), and Playwright browser specs under tests/ for create, delete and the empty-field error. Browser specs must not leave changes in .sandbox-data (use a temporary SANDBOX_DATA_DIR or restore it).

House rule: add a line to CHANGELOG.md.

Done when: on http://127.0.0.1:4173/customers you can add a customer with the form and see it in the list, delete it with its row's button, and see the error when a field is empty. All the data-testids above are present, and lint and every test pass.
